resource_limits.scope: each proxy container (EQProxy and HAProxy); origin and generator are outside

disclosure.topology: one macOS host; origin + both proxies in Linux containers on one Docker bridge; oha on the host against published loopback ports; no CPU affinity.
disclosure.origin: scripts/bench_v092_h1_backends.py (one asyncio process, /1k and /1m, TCP_NODELAY, honors Connection: close and HTTP/1.0)

generator.warmup: one discarded run per product and scenario: 5s for S-H1-01/02, 2s for S-H1-03
generator.correction: not applied: oha 1.14.0 ignores --latency-correction without -q, and the closed-loop scenario has no honest offered rate for -q. Full raw histograms are published; percentiles are not CO-corrected.

scenario_interpretation.S-H1-03: HTTP/1.1 new connection per request, 1 KiB payload

configs.s-h1-eqproxy.toml:
schema_version = 1
shutdown_grace = "5s"

[listener.web]
listen = "0.0.0.0:19601"
mode = "http"
backend = "api"
maxconn = 4096

[backend.api]
server = "172.22.0.2:19002"
configs.s-h1-haproxy.cfg:
global
  log stdout format raw local0
  maxconn 4096
defaults
  log global
  mode http
  option httplog
  option http-keep-alive
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 60s
  timeout server 60s
  timeout http-request 5s
frontend web
  bind *:19611
  default_backend api
backend api
  server s1 172.22.0.2:19002 maxconn 4096

limitations: Only 3 of the 18 BENCHMARK_PLAN scenarios were executed in this slice; the roadmap item remains open.
One macOS host with Docker Desktop; generator and containers share the host, and CPU affinity/isolated generator, proxy and backend machines from the plan were not available.
Latency percentiles are not coordinated-omission corrected (see disclosure.generator.correction).

S-H1-03 uses a reduced connection count and a 5s window on hosts whose ephemeral-port range cannot sustain the 50 x 10s setting; both products use identical client settings. The applied values are recorded in disclosure.connections and disclosure.generator.durations.
The EQProxy image is built from the working tree, not a published release artifact.
A series whose direct sink did not exceed 1.20x the faster proxy is marked invalid/Not comparable.
